display.subtitle: Real horsepower
description: When wheels and windmills run out of stress, go thermal. A §bSteam Engine§r
on a heated §bBoiler§r (a Blaze Burner under a water tank) is the dense
power source that runs a serious factory.
Build a Steam Engine to complete this beat. Scale the boiler's heat and
water to push far more stress than any wheel.
